ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: Module receives global clock input for synchronous logic
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in mem_access and bus_feedback processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: Module receives async active-low reset; clears internal state
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then rden <= '0' in bus_feedback process

ports.name: bus_req_i
ports.function: Module receives bus request record (address and control)
ports.evidence: addr indexed mem_rom_c; stb and rw used to set rden

ports.name: bus_req_i.addr
ports.function: Module receives address for ROM access (read index)

ports.name: bus_req_i.data
ports.function: Module receives bus write data (unused by ROM)
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.data is not referenced anywhere in the module

ports.name: bus_req_i.ben
ports.evidence: no references to bus_req_i.ben in RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.stb
ports.function: Module receives bus strobe signaling a valid request
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in bus_feedback

ports.name: bus_req_i.rw
ports.function: Module receives read/write flag; used to detect read accesses
ports.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) in bus_feedback

ports.name: bus_req_i.src
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.src is not referenced in the module

ports.name: bus_req_i.priv
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.priv not referenced in this RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.debug
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.debug is not referenced anywhere in module

ports.name: bus_req_i.amoop
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.amoop is not referenced in this module

ports.name: bus_req_i.lock
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.lock not referenced anywhere in the RTL

ports.name: bus_req_i.fence
ports.evidence: bus_req_i.fence is not referenced in the module

ports.name: bus_rsp_o
ports.function: Module drives bus response record (data, ack, err)
ports.evidence: data<=rdata when rden; ack<=rden; err<='0' in architecture

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.err
ports.function: Module drives response error flag tied low

ports.name: bus_rsp_o.data
ports.function: Module drives response data output with ROM read value

signals.name: rden
signals.evidence: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw); drives bus_rsp_o.ack

signals.name: rdata
signals.function: Registered ROM read data for bus response
signals.evidence: Assigned from mem_rom_c at clock edge; drives bus_rsp_o.data
